## Failure mode
Describe the access-revocation question using a hypothetical example.

## Desired observation
What should still work, what should stop working, and what would count as an inconclusive result?

## Constraints
Name only generic protocols or product categories.

This is a public issue. Do not include employer details, real identities, IP addresses, domains, logs, tokens, private configurations, or customer information. An inquiry is not a commitment to provide a pilot or support.
